description: Rozhlasové analógové pozemské vysielanie. FM vysielače is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.geocloud.gov.sk. Details of permitted analogue radio transmitters. Coverage: SK. The portal shows the English title as "Radio analogue terrestrial broadcasting. FM transmitters" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
